api_lessons: Pre-v5 materials had texture slots set via material.setParameter("colorTex"|"specTex"|"bumpTex"|"reflTex"|"transTex", path, false); this broke with the v5 node-based material system.

MatMovie found texture paths by parsing material.rib(); in Cheetah3D 5.0.3 this fails with 'm.rib is not a function' (Material.rib() is still listed in the 8.1.1 reference, so re-test before relying on it).

A script object's custom parameter (e.g. 'frame') must be keyframed to animate: ctrl/right-click the record button and choose 'record frame'; the parameter is not offered in the key editor automatically.
As of 2011 (v5) the node material system was not scriptable (per Frank Beckmann).
notes: Needs materials whose texture is the first image of a sequence (originally named .mov). Reports of 'All Frames' not overriding the frame value (2008) and render crashes in 4.6.3. Frank says a 2013 rewrite by Todd exists elsewhere (showthread.php?p=80541). Native movie textures since v7.

title: 2 splines below addObject(SWEEP)
summary: Q&A: building a parametric window frame by adding a Sweep with two rectangle splines under a polygon script; poster couldn't get a SplineCore from the sweep.

evidence.author: MarkusR
evidence.quote: I stuck at sweep because I not get the core()

evidence.author: MarkusR
evidence.quote: seems I not saw the object type rect and spline ..

api_lessons: A SWEEP object from doc.addObject(SWEEP) is a creator, so it has no SplineCore to draw into; add spline child objects instead (e.g. doc.addObject(RECT) or SPLINE) and parent them under the sweep.

Pattern for child objects in a polygon script's buildObject: create once (if obj.childCount()==0) with doc.addObject(...) and obj.addChildAtIndex(child, i), then update their parameters (e.g. BOX sizeX/sizeY/sizeZ) on every rebuild and call child.update().
notes: Poster self-resolved by finding the RECT and SPLINE object types; no final code posted. Also asked how to clear all paths of a spline before rebuilding (unanswered).
